title: Find the mistake: questions
instructions: Each reported question has **one** mistake – or no mistake at all. Find the wrong word and write the correct sentence.

items.sentence: Tyler asked me where did I live.
items.answer: Tyler asked me where I lived.
items.hint: No *do / does / did* in reported questions.

items.sentence: Aisha asked if Mila liked pizza.
items.hint: Yes/no question with *if* – is everything right?

items.sentence: Diego asked Mila that she wanted a drink.
items.answer: Diego asked Mila [if|whether] she wanted a drink.

items.sentence: Mrs Moreno wanted to know when was the bus leaving.
items.answer: Mrs Moreno wanted to know when the bus was leaving.

items.sentence: Sofia asked me if I can help her.
items.answer: Sofia asked me [if|whether] I could help her.
items.hint: Check the backshift of the modal verb.

items.sentence: Mr Okafor asked Mila whether she had finished her project.
items.hint: Check the word order and the tense.

items.sentence: Tyler wanted to know why Mila is laughing.
items.answer: Tyler wanted to know why Mila was laughing.

items.sentence: Coach Brooks asked us if we will come early.
items.answer: Coach Brooks asked us [if|whether] we would come early.
